findings.message: Do not inherit the previous attempt's resultRef into a new repair attempt.
findings.trigger: A2 submits DONE, receives a revise report, and A3 starts. A3 stops before submitting a result. startTask spreads A2's resultRef into A3; recoverReservation clears activeTaskId but only resets the task if !current.resultRef, so A3 stays running and points at A2/result.json.
findings.impact: The documented interrupted repair recovery leaves a stopped task permanently running and removes the pointer needed for another recover call. Coordinator next continues to say the old worker is running instead of restarting the repair.
